import jobs

def test_stable_dedup_by_source_source_id():
    """Test that deduplication uses (source, source_id) as key."""
    rows = [
        {'title': 'A', 'source': 'src1', 'source_id': '1'},
        {'title': 'A', 'source': 'src1', 'source_id': '2'},
        {'title': 'A', 'source': 'src1', 'source_id': '1'},
    ]
    result = jobs.unique_jobs(rows)
    # First occurrence of (src1, 1) should win, second occurrence dropped
    assert len(result) == 2, f"Expected 2 rows, got {len(result)}"
    assert result[0]['title'] == 'A'
    assert result[0]['source'] == 'src1'
    assert result[0]['source_id'] == '1'
    assert result[1]['title'] == 'A'
    assert result[1]['source'] == 'src1'
    assert result[1]['source_id'] == '2'

def test_no_merge_across_sources():
    """Test that rows from different sources are not merged."""
    rows = [
        {'title': 'A', 'source': 'src1', 'source_id': '1'},
        {'title': 'A', 'source': 'src2', 'source_id': '1'},
    ]
    result = jobs.unique_jobs(rows)
    assert len(result) == 2, f"Expected 2 rows, got {len(result)}"

def test_none_source_id_kept_separately():
    """Test that None source_id is handled separately."""
    rows = [
        {'title': 'A', 'source': 'src1', 'source_id': '1'},
        {'title': 'A', 'source': 'src1', 'source_id': None},
        {'title': 'A', 'source': 'src1', 'source_id': None},
    ]
    result = jobs.unique_jobs(rows)
    # (src1, '1') and (src1, None) are different keys
    assert len(result) == 2, f"Expected 2 rows, got {len(result)}"

def test_empty_source_id_kept_separately():
    """Test that empty string source_id is handled separately."""
    rows = [
        {'title': 'A', 'source': 'src1', 'source_id': '1'},
        {'title': 'A', 'source': 'src1', 'source_id': ''},
        {'title': 'A', 'source': 'src1', 'source_id': ''},
    ]
    result = jobs.unique_jobs(rows)
    # (src1, '1') and (src1, '') are different keys
    assert len(result) == 2, f"Expected 2 rows, got {len(result)}"

def test_no_mutation_of_input():
    """Test that input is not mutated."""
    rows = [
        {'title': 'A', 'source': 'src1', 'source_id': '1'},
    ]
    rows_copy = rows.copy()
    result = jobs.unique_jobs(rows)
    assert rows == rows_copy, "Input was mutated"

def test_first_occurrence_wins():
    """Test stable first occurrence wins."""
    rows = [
        {'title': 'B', 'source': 'src1', 'source_id': '1'},
        {'title': 'A', 'source': 'src1', 'source_id': '1'},
        {'title': 'B', 'source': 'src1', 'source_id': '1'},
    ]
    result = jobs.unique_jobs(rows)
    assert len(result) == 1, f"Expected 1 row, got {len(result)}"
    assert result[0]['title'] == 'B'
    assert result[0]['source'] == 'src1'
    assert result[0]['source_id'] == '1'

if __name__ == '__main__':
    test_stable_dedup_by_source_source_id()
    test_no_merge_across_sources()
    test_none_source_id_kept_separately()
    test_empty_source_id_kept_separately()
    test_no_mutation_of_input()
    test_first_occurrence_wins()
    print("All tests passed!")
